contract.definition: The accounting basis (Cash or Accrual) on which the charity prepared its reported financial information for the reporting period, as published by the ACNC. A reporting-basis classification, not a financial measure.

The date by which the charity's Annual Information Statement for the reporting year is due to be lodged with the ACNC, as published in the AIS dataset. This is a regulatory lodgement deadline, not a licence or registration date.

The date on which the ACNC received the charity's Annual Information Statement for the reporting year, as published in the AIS dataset. This is a lodgement receipt date, not the charity's establishment or registration date.
Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity is a basic religious charity for the reporting year, recorded as y/n in the source.

Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity conducted any activities during its reporting period, recorded as y/n. A 'n' answer is accompanied by a free-text reason in a separate field and is not evidence the charity is inactive or deregistered.

Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity submitted its financial report to a cooperative or other regulator rather than to the ACNC (y/n), as recorded in the 'coop financial report submitted to regulator' column. A lodgement-channel indicator, not a registration status; the exact regulator and whether it replaces ACNC lodgement are not asserted.

The end date of the reporting period covered by the charity's financial report as lodged with the ACNC. Defines the period scope for the charity's financial figures; it is not a financial year-end attribute or a licence end date.

The start date of the reporting period covered by the charity's financial report as lodged with the ACNC. Defines the period scope for the charity's financial figures; it is not a registration or licence start date.
The date on which the ACNC received the charity's financial report for the reporting period. A document lodgement receipt date, distinct from the AIS receipt date and from the report's period dates.

The type of financial statement the charity lodged with the ACNC, e.g. special purpose or general purpose financial statements (including simplified disclosure variants). A reporting-framework classification, not a legal form or entity type.
values: General purpose financial statements - simplified disclosure

contract.definition: Total full-time-equivalent staff the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own reporting period, expressed as an FTE number of persons (decimal, e.g. 4.14). This is a workload-equivalent measure, not a headcount and not a monetary amount.

Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity is an incorporated association, recorded as y/n. This is a self-reported association attribute, not an inference of legal form from the charity name.

Free-text description supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement of the international activities it undertook during the reporting period. Self-reported narrative retained verbatim; it does not by itself establish a country of operation.

Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity undertook international activities by operating overseas including programs during the reporting period, recorded as y/n.

Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity undertook other international activities not covered by the operating-overseas or goods/services-transfer categories during the reporting period, recorded as y/n.

Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity undertook international activities by transferring goods or services overseas during the reporting period, recorded as y/n.

Free-text explanation supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for why it did not conduct activities during the reporting period. Publisher wording is retained verbatim; it is self-reported narrative, not a regulator finding.

Free-text description supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement of the 'other' international activities it undertook during the reporting period. Self-reported narrative retained verbatim.

Free-text description supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement of how it pursued its charitable purposes during the reporting period. Self-reported narrative retained verbatim, not a regulator classification or an ANZSIC activity code.

The ACNC registration status of the charity as published in the Annual Information Statement, including revocation reasons such as voluntary revocation or double defaulter. This is a charity-regulator status, not a company legal status or a licence status.
values: Voluntarily Revoked Not Entitled To Be A Charity

contract.definition: Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity's financial report is consolidated with more than one entity (y/n). A reporting-scope indicator, not evidence of group structure or ownership.

Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity's financial report for the reporting period carries a modification (y/n). A report-quality indicator, not a registration or compliance status.

The type of modification the auditor or reviewer applied to the charity's financial report, as published by the ACNC (e.g. qualified/qualification, disclaimed/disclaimer, adverse). Only meaningful where the report modification flag is y; unlisted source labels are withheld rather than guessed.

The ACNC charity size classification (Small, Medium or Large) reported for the charity in its Annual Information Statement. This is a regulator reporting classification, not a measure of company scale, revenue band or legal form.

Number of people the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement as staff of a given employment category (full time, part time or casual) for its own reporting period. A headcount of people, not full-time-equivalent staff and not a monetary amount; a reported zero is retained as published and is not evidence of no activity.

State or territory incorporated-association registration number held by the charity, qualified by the jurisdiction whose association-number column supplied it. Values are publisher-formatted strings (e.g. INC9886754, A0005374L) and are not normalised across states.

Number of volunteers the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own reporting period. A count of volunteers, distinct from paid staff headcount and from full-time-equivalent staff; a reported zero is retained as published.

Publisher-recorded y/n flag from the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity reported fundraising activity in a given jurisdiction or online, qualified by the jurisdiction (or 'online' for the national online-fundraising column). A 'y' flag is a self-reported activity indicator and does not by itself prove a registration number exists.

Publisher-assigned fundraising registration or licence number held by a charity for a specific Australian state or territory, taken verbatim from that jurisdiction's fundraising-number column. Formats differ by jurisdiction (e.g. CH2136, CCP2996, C/10450, FR0017060, CFN/26748) and are not normalised across states; a placeholder value such as 00000 is retained as published and is not evidence of a valid registration.

fundraising_authorisation.rationale: Each populated fundraising number column evidences a jurisdiction-specific fundraising registration held by the charity; the number is the only identifier present.

edge.rationale: Fundraising number columns (act, nsw, qld, sa, tas, vic, wa) are populated only for charities holding that jurisdiction's fundraising registration; the corresponding fundraising flag columns indicate activity, not the authorisation itself.

definition.definition: Charity holds a state or territory fundraising registration evidenced by a fundraising number column for that jurisdiction.
